decoded.meaning: ERROR{ VALUE u16=0x0031 (tr::schema::not_found), DESCRIPTION "settings.history_keep_last" } — the STREAM ring depth has NO wire surface at all (§5.7)
decoded.note: the wire-observable half of RFC-0022 §3.C: the depth is set host-side by graph_t::set_history_depth and neither read nor written remotely, so both a read and a write of the old knob name resolve to nothing
